name: ICP Registration Home 404
author: getpicion99

sections.description:
ICP Registration Home 404 is a lightweight WordPress plugin designed specifically for websites during the ICP filing/registration period.

After enabling:
* Unauthenticated visitors will receive a 404 response when accessing the homepage
* Logged-in administrators can still access the homepage normally
* Effectively meets access restriction requirements during the ICP review process

The plugin provides:
* Admin settings page
* One-click enable / disable
* Quick links to usage tutorials, VPS recommendations, and native IP recommendations
* Does not affect themes or other pages

Compatible with WordPress themes and custom themes.

Features

  • 🔒 Hide homepage during ICP registration (unauthenticated users only)
  • 🔄 Returns a standard 404 HTTP status code
  • ⚙️ Admin settings page with enable/disable switch
  • 🖼 Plugin introduction image display
  • 📘 Usage tutorial
  • 🧩 Lightweight, no dependencies, no performance impact

Usage

  1. Open the plugin settings page
  2. Check “Enable homepage hiding”
  3. Save settings
  4. Unauthenticated visitors will receive a 404 response on the homepage

Logged-in administrators can still access the homepage for content management.

Author

Yong Design Network
https://getpicion.com
sections.installation:
1. Download and extract the plugin
  2. Upload the icp-404-home directory to /wp-content/plugins/
  3. Go to WordPress Admin → Plugins → Activate ICP Registration Home 404
  4. Navigate to Settings → ICP Registration Home 404 to configure
sections.faq:
Will this affect search engines?

The plugin is intended for temporary use during ICP registration. Simply disable it after approval.

Will it affect the admin area or other pages?

No. It only affects the homepage (is_home) for unauthenticated users.

Is cache/CDN supported?

Cache headers are disabled. If you are using a CDN, it is recommended to disable homepage caching during ICP registration.
